This suggests potential overvaluation and caution should be exercised. [E52] While Scintilla Commercial & Credit Ltd has a positive screen reason indicating earnings growth is accelerating, this alone does not justify its current valuation given other negative indicators such as low ROA and underperforming sales growth.
